methodologyNote: Measured via page views across tracked network traffic.
metricLabel: market share of tracked page views / usage
aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome led browsers (mobile) in United Kingdom at 48.11% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Safari ranked second at 43.83%, followed by Samsung Internet at 6.12%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browsers (mobile) in United Kingdom?
faqs.answer: Chrome leads at 48.11% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-market-share/mobile/united-kingdom.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browsers (mobile) in United Kingdom?
faqs.answer: Chrome (48.11%), Safari (43.83%), Samsung Internet (6.12%) in October 2026.
